item.description:
This page's content changed since the last check. Visit the page directly to review the update.
What changed (text excerpt): Added: + Home + Helpful Links + Commission Guidance + Meetings & Minutes + Annual Reports + Mediation Payments + Consumer tools + Attorney Referral Listing + Sexual Harassment Trainer Listing + Mediation Handbook + How Do I? + Check the status of a Complaint + Request an Accommodation + Contact MHRC + Emerging Issues + Covid19 Issues + Homeless Pilot Project + Latest News + The Commission conducts operations both in person and via electronic means according to agency policies that apply to parties, attorneys, and the public. + Please find our policies about how to file documents/pleadings electronically and otherwise + here + and our policies about public meetings + here + . Please contact us at + info@mhrc.maine.gov + or + 207- + 624-6290 + with questions. + August 24, 2026, MHRC meeting agenda ( + PDF + ) (Live on + YouTube + ) + MHRC and MDOL, along with Clara Porter from Prevention, Action, Change, and Peter Lowe, Esq., from Brann & Isaacson, present a + joint training on sexual harassment + in the workplace. This training can be used by employers to comply with the 26 M.R.S. Section 807 requirement to provide training to new employees. Please note that presenting this training alone + does not + meet the training requirement for supervisory and managerial employees. This video is ASL-interpreted. + MHRC Guidance on HUD Change + to Definition of Assistance Animal + October 31, 2025: + An [diff truncated]
